requirements.summary: Apply a coherent Apple HIG–inspired visual theme (surfaces + typography) across all existing pages without changing layout/navigation structure.
acceptanceCriteria: All pages share a consistent surface system (background, card, popover, borders) and typography scale (headings/body/captions) without changing navigation structure or removing existing features.
No page contains the current ‘mixed style’ patterns (e.g., some areas use heavy uppercase/black weights while others use sentence case) without an intentional, consistent system.
Visual theme changes are implemented via shared Tailwind tokens/utilities (e.g., in frontend/src/index.css and Tailwind classes), not one-off inline styles per component unless truly necessary.

file_operations.description: Evolve the global theme tokens and utilities toward an Apple HIG-inspired surface system (translucent/blurred surfaces, subtle borders, calm contrast) and a consistent typography hierarchy (headings/body/captions). Add reusable utility classes for app background, glass cards/panels, and consistent text styles so pages can adopt the system without one-off inline styles.

Extend Tailwind theme to support the updated surface/typography system (e.g., additional semantic colors/opacity patterns, consistent radius, shadow/elevation presets, and typography scale alignment) so pages can implement the theme via shared tokens/utilities.
Align app-wide container/background and view transition wrapper styling with the new theme utilities (keep the existing view routing and layout structure unchanged).

requirements.summary: Unify interaction feedback and motion across components using existing motion tokens/easing; ensure consistent hover/press/focus/disabled/loading states and reduced-motion behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: Hover, press, and focus states feel consistent across primary/secondary/ghost/outline buttons, clickable cards, accordion triggers, and icon buttons.
All transitions use the same timing/easing family (Apple-like curve) and respect prefers-reduced-motion (no noticeable animations when reduced motion is enabled).
Loading and disabled states are visually distinct and consistent (e.g., ‘Generating…’, ‘Exporting…’, ‘Saving…’) without layout shift or jitter.

file_operations.description: Normalize interactive state utilities (hover/press/focus/disabled/loading) to consistently use existing motion tokens (--motion-hover/press/component/modal) and --ease-apple. Ensure focus styles are consistent via shared utilities (e.g., focus-ring), and confirm reduced-motion rules cover transitions/animations app-wide.

Apply consistent interaction feedback to high-frequency controls (toolbar buttons, accordion triggers, NFT cards, modal close/action buttons) using shared motion/focus utilities; ensure loading/disabled labels do not cause layout shifts.
Unify nav item hover/press/focus/active feedback for desktop and mobile navigation using shared motion/focus utilities, ensuring consistent timing/easing and stable layout.

requirements.summary: Standardize user-facing copy to a calm, premium English tone (replace ALL-CAPS UI/toasts/labels with sentence/title case where appropriate) without changing behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: Toast messages throughout Workshop/Preview/Forge/Vault are no longer ALL-CAPS (e.g., “Layer added”, “Trait deleted”, “No valid combination after 100 attempts”).
Primary page headings and section labels use a consistent casing strategy (no random uppercase blocks) while preserving meaning.
No user-facing text is removed in a way that makes workflows unclear; copy edits only improve clarity/tone.

file_operations.description: Update user-facing copy (toasts, headings, button labels, empty states) to sentence/title case and calmer phrasing while preserving all existing Workshop behavior and regions (sidebar + main panel).
Update Preview page user-facing strings (toasts, button label, empty state, pixel mode labels) to a calm English tone (no ALL-CAPS) without changing behavior.

Update Forge (Builder) page user-facing copy (toasts, headings, tab labels, button labels, empty states, confirmation dialog text) to remove ALL-CAPS and align with the global tone without changing workflows.
Audit and refine Vault user-facing copy (toasts, button labels, empty states, progress text, modal labels) to keep consistent casing/tone across the page (no shouty ALL-CAPS).

Update the save status label styling/casing to align with the calm copy system (avoid heavy uppercase/black-weight presentation), while preserving the fixed-width behavior that prevents header layout shift.

requirements.summary: Polish global navigation and header responsiveness: consistent active state styling, stable alignment/spacing, and premium mobile menu interactions.
acceptanceCriteria: Header alignment remains stable across view changes; no noticeable layout shifts when save status changes or when opening/closing the mobile menu.
Mobile navigation tap targets meet a comfortable minimum and have consistent feedback (hover/press/focus).
Active navigation item styling is consistent between desktop and mobile nav.

file_operations.description: Refine header and navigation styling using the shared theme/motion utilities: consistent active state treatment across desktop/mobile, improved spacing/alignment, stable header height, and predictable mobile menu open/close behavior (no layout shift). Use existing shadcn-ui Button patterns already in use; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Adjust SaveStatusIndicator typography and state presentation to reduce visual jitter and ensure stable alignment in header across status changes (keep fixed width, improve calm premium feel).
Ensure global tap-target comfort and focus/press feedback utilities support navigation items consistently across breakpoints (retain existing navigation structure).

requirements.summary: Refine Dashboard UI (cards + dialogs + empty state) for spacing, hierarchy, and interaction feedback while preserving existing fields and flows.
acceptanceCriteria: Project cards have consistent padding, typography hierarchy, and hover states; action icons (settings/delete) are discoverable and accessible without feeling hidden or jumpy.
Dialogs (New project / Project settings) use consistent surface styling, spacing, and focus treatment matching the global theme.
Empty state (“No projects yet”) looks intentional and aligned with the rest of the theme.

file_operations.description: Refine project card surfaces/typography/spacing to match the global Apple HIG-inspired theme; improve action icon discoverability (avoid hover-only affordances on mobile) and unify hover/press/focus feedback. Update dialogs and empty state surfaces to match the shared surface system. Use existing shadcn-ui Card/Dialog/Button/Input/Label/Switch components already in use; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Align the destructive confirmation dialog surface, spacing, and typography with the global theme (consistent modal surface/backdrop feel) while keeping the underlying confirm flow intact. Use existing shadcn-ui AlertDialog components already in use; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Refine Workshop UI for calmer typography and improved affordances (layers list, drag/reorder, rename, trait cards, upload) while preserving existing functionality and layout regions.
acceptanceCriteria: Workshop sidebar (layers) has consistent item sizing, selection state, and drag affordance styling; rename/edit controls are aligned and do not visually ‘fight’ the drag handle.
Trait cards have consistent thumbnail framing, spacing, and action button styling; destructive actions remain clearly destructive.
Empty states (“No layers”, “Select layer”, “No traits”) match the app theme and don’t look like dead ends.

file_operations.description: Restyle Workshop sidebar and main panel to adopt the shared surface/typography/motion system (calmer casing/weights, consistent item sizing, clearer selection + drag affordance). Improve alignment of drag handle vs rename controls, and standardize trait card framing/actions (clear destructive affordance). Preserve all existing functionality and the sidebar+main layout regions. Use existing shadcn-ui components already in use (Button/Card/Input/Select/Slider/Dialog/ScrollArea); verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Add/adjust shared utilities for list items, draggable affordances, and thumbnail framing so Workshop styling remains consistent and not implemented as one-off inline styles.

requirements.summary: Refine Preview page UI to match the global theme (preview frame, generate action, pixel mode toggle panel) with immediate, consistent feedback.
acceptanceCriteria: Preview’s custom-styled elements (frame gradients, button styles, toggle panel) are brought into the same design system as the rest of the app (shared tokens/utilities).
The ‘Generate random mix’ action clearly communicates loading/disabled state without jarring styling changes.
Pixel mode toggle area is aligned, readable, and consistent with other switch rows in the app.

file_operations.description: Replace custom one-off styling (inline gradients/shadows and ad-hoc colors) with the shared theme surface utilities for the preview frame and toggle panel; convert the generate action to consistent Button-like interaction states (hover/press/focus/disabled/loading) using shared motion utilities. Keep existing layout and behavior; use the existing shadcn-ui Switch component already in use; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Introduce/adjust reusable utilities for framed preview surfaces (glass/elevation/border) so Preview can use shared tokens/utilities rather than inline styles.

requirements.summary: Refine Forge (Builder) UI for consistent modal/panel surfaces, tabs, selection states, and action feedback while preserving workflow and screen structure.
acceptanceCriteria: Forge modal uses the same modal/backdrop styling and motion system as other dialogs/modals in the app (consistent blur, elevation, corner radius, enter/exit feel).
Genesis trait selection tiles have a clear selected state and consistent hover/press behavior.
Direct injection queue items and remove buttons have consistent affordances and do not rely on ‘only appears on hover’ patterns on mobile.

file_operations.description: Unify the Forge modal/backdrop styling and motion with the global modal system (consistent blur/elevation/radius and reduced-motion behavior). Standardize tab styling, selected states for trait tiles, and queue item/remove button affordances (ensure not hover-only on mobile). Preserve the existing Forge workflow and overall structure. Use existing shadcn-ui primitives already in use (Button/AlertDialog); verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Add/adjust shared utilities for modal surfaces/backdrops, tabs/segmented controls, and selectable tiles to keep Builder styling consistent across the app.

requirements.summary: Refine Vault UI for readability and reduced clutter across toolbar, filters sidebar, grid cards, detail modal, and progress/loading states; keep behavior intact.
acceptanceCriteria: Vault toolbar elements (publishing controls area, search, sort buttons, export) align cleanly and maintain consistent sizing across breakpoints.
NFT cards share consistent hover/press/focus states and typography; compact vs grid view modes feel like variants of the same system.
Detail modal styling matches the global theme (surface, border, spacing, typography) and retains clear primary/secondary actions.

file_operations.description: Polish Vault layout spacing/alignment across toolbar, filters sidebar, grid cards, progress areas, and detail modal using the shared surface/typography/motion utilities. Ensure card variants (compact vs grid) share the same base component feel, and modal actions are clearly styled with consistent focus/disabled states. Use existing shadcn-ui components already in use (Card/Input/Progress/ScrollArea/Accordion/Switch/Label/Button); verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Align the view mode toggle’s interactive states and casing/typography with the unified button/toggle system for consistency in the Vault toolbar. Use existing shadcn-ui Button patterns already in use; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Align publishing controls UI (buttons, progress, status text) with the unified interaction/motion/copy system to reduce clutter and improve consistent feedback across states. Use existing shadcn-ui components already in use; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Refine Settings page polish (form panel + preview panel) for spacing, consistent section styling, and predictable interactive states without changing functionality.
acceptanceCriteria: Settings sections (Publishing status, How it works, Pinata JWT, Solana creators, Dimensions, Metadata format, templates, royalties) have consistent spacing, headings, and surface treatment.
Form controls (inputs/selects/switches/buttons) look and behave consistently with other pages (focus rings, disabled states, helper text).
The metadata preview panel has a readable code style (monospace sizing/line-height) and aligns visually with the theme without feeling visually heavy.

file_operations.description: Refine Settings panel surfaces, section spacing, and heading hierarchy to match the global theme; standardize form control focus/disabled/helper text styling via shared utilities; tune metadata preview panel monospace styling (size/line-height/background/border) for readability without visual heaviness. Preserve the existing left form + right preview layout and all Settings functionality. Use existing shadcn-ui components already in use (Input/Label/Textarea/Select/Switch/Separator/Alert/Button); verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Add/adjust shared utilities for form section cards/rows and code-preview blocks so Settings styling remains consistent and token-driven across the app.
